## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues when relevant.

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results and any remaining limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and its documentation is current.
- [ ] Examples, logs and screenshots contain only synthetic or public information.
- [ ] Secrets, client data and internal infrastructure details are absent.
- [ ] Shared behavior was considered for Core; logging follows the shared contract.
- [ ] Third-party notices and license obligations are preserved.
